polityNote: Federal Republic of Cameroon from the reunification of 1961-10-01, United Republic from 1972, Republic of Cameroon from 1984. Units are drawn as actually administered: the Bakassi peninsula (in the NE Sud-Ouest atom) was administered by Nigeria until 2008-08-14, and Nigeria administered Darak and other Lake Chad villages (in the NE Extrême-Nord atom, which follows the ICJ line) until December 2003 / July 2004.
